command: set deviceconfig system service disable-http yes
description: Disable insecure HTTP administrative management on PAN-OS.

command: set deviceconfig system service disable-telnet yes
description: Disable insecure Telnet administrative service on PAN-OS.

command: set deviceconfig system service disable-ssh no
description: Enable secure SSHv2 administration on PAN-OS.

command: set deviceconfig system login-lockout failed-attempts 3 lockout-time 15
description: Enable admin lockout policy after failed login attempts.

command: set shared log-settings syslog SYSLOG-SERVER server 10.10.40.50 facility LOG_USER port 514
description: Enable remote syslog server logging in PAN-OS.
